posts.name: Waffles
posts.cooked:
Ran into one of them recently. I was sitting in queue murdering bots farming herbs as one does in pvp (usually get a bounty before dying)

Then I ran into one of them… was the usual riding a druid and mining combo. Killed the druid off the bad but the hunter bot weirdly started combat. Opened with a trap to create distance then followed up with slows and stuns. After the druid came back to to life it started healing the hunter and tried to stay out of my range…

Creepy thing is after killing six or seven times I got messages wishing me ill and saying uncourteous things about my mother.

Stay safe out there. I had killed dozens of bots before them but the bots…they are evolving.
